english.note: Use this for a building or piece of real estate, especially in property or legal contexts.
Use this when focusing on a property or properties as assets, especially in business or investment contexts.
Use this when the premises are being viewed as a property or real-estate holding rather than simply as a place.
Use this specifically for real estate or a property consisting of land and buildings.
